skills.description: Build large or complex projects through a gated, multi-phase pipeline: first interrogate the user until requirements are concrete (asking questions with options and a recommendation), then persist four files to disk — REQUIREMENTS.md (requirements and decisions), RULES.md (project pitfalls and red lines), PLAN.md (phase breakdown with progress and evidence), tests/ (one directory per phase, must pass before a phase can be closed). Use this skill when the user wants to build/refactor a non-trivial project from scratch, asks for a multi-phase plan, wants staged delivery with tests as an acceptance gate, asks to generate RULES.md/PLAN.md, or says things like \"先出方案再写代码\", \"分阶段做\", \"每阶段测试通过再继续\", \"大项目\". Do NOT use for one-off small scripts or single-file edits.
skills.description_zh:
phase-gated-project 是一个给 AI Agent 用的项目管理技能。它解决一个很具体的问题：
AI 写大项目时通常不是写不出代码，而是会"假装做完"——需求没搞清楚就开工、约束只存在于
对话里、进度无人可查、功能看着完成了却跑不起来。

它把四件事外置到磁盘：REQUIREMENTS.md（需求与决策）、RULES.md（易错点与红线）、
PLAN.md（唯一进度事实源）、tests/（阶段测试与运行记录）。再用 4 个门禁脚本做确定性判定：
需求没对齐不许开工，阶段测试没通过不许收工，每条已勾选的任务必须附「文件:行号 · 测试用例名」
作为证据。

支持跨会话中断恢复——新会话先读文件、跑门禁、复述现状，再动手。纯 Python 标准库实现，
零第三方依赖，Windows / macOS / Linux 通用。
skills.name: 拒绝假完成：阶段门禁式项目交付
